items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they came in to get introduced to you

ctx.x: Probably the largest crowd you’d played for up to that time maybe...

You know, that’s not I remembered it. They turned out really well knowing him, I think. I remember that we were in a tent, and they came in to get introduced to you, and it was a small skinny guy in a t-shirt... So then I went out to hear them. I thought they’d played before you, but maybe I’m wrong. And I remember thinking, “Wow!” I was used to seeing big bands either all sitting down, or his trio playing suits, and he was running all around the stage like he always did, and I’d never seen anyone do that...and…
